verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented public Developer API. A live probe fetched its OpenAPI spec ("Ramp Developer API" v1, 174 paths including /developer/v1/transactions). The docs cover OAuth 2.0 with client-credentials and authorization-code grants and granular resource:permission scopes, plus endpoint guides for transactions, bills, virtual cards via the Vault API, custom records and AI usage, as well as webhooks, a sandbox at demo-api.ramp.com, and machine-readable llms.txt and llms-api.txt exports aimed at agents. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence of authenticated API calls actually working end-to-end (probes only confirmed the published spec and docs are reachable).
